title: UP DELEd 2026 Online Counselling
postName: Diploma in Elementary Education – online counselling
vacancyDetails: Diploma in Elementary Education – online counselling
qualification: As per UP DELEd 2026 counselling brochure
selectionProcess: Online form / counselling registration → Choice filling (if any) → Allotment / exam
documentsRequired: Photo, signature, educational documents, category certificate and photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://updeled.gov.in/
2. Open UP DElEd Registration 2026 or the DElEd Activity page
3. Log in with the registered credentials
4. Complete the institution choice for the counselling phase shown on the official portal
5. Save the submitted choice and acknowledgement
shortDescription: UP DElEd 2026 counselling: registration notice dated 10 June 2026, counselling process notice dated 07 August 2026 and second-phase institution choice deadline of 10 September 2026.
content:
Exam Regulatory Authority, Uttar Pradesh published the UP DElEd 2026 registration and counselling notices. The official portal lists the registration notice dated 10 June 2026, the counselling process notice dated 07 August 2026, and asks reserved, special-reservation and other-state candidates to complete institution choice in the second phase by 10 September 2026.

Follow the current instructions and candidate login links on the official UP DElEd portal.
